chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Muḥammad ibn Marwān, from Ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام:

A man dies during travel among women, and there is no man with them; what should they do with him? He عليه السلام said: They should wrap him up in his clothes and bury him, and they should not perform ghusl on him.

key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel, the circumstance in which the death occurs
key_terms.ثِيَابِهِ: his clothes, used for wrapping him

ai.seo_question: What should women do if a man dies during travel and no male is present to wash and bury him?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling for the case of a man who dies while traveling and is accompanied only by women with no male present. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that he should be wrapped in his clothes and buried without being washed, indicating the legal handling of the deceased under conditions of gender-restricted access.
